topicContext: Read all 810 unique complete questions from the 30 packet topic digests, plus batch comparisons. Only planned questions are changed.

question.question: In The Princess and the Frog, what song introduces Dr. Facilier's shadow magic?

replacement.question: Which Disney animated film features the villain song 'Friends on the Other Side,' sung by the shadow-dealing villain Dr. Facilier?

retirements.reason: Inverse film/song association for the same Dr. Facilier performance; #1511 already names the song, performer and shadow context. Knowing that mapping solves #1265 without a new fact.

question.question: In Soul, what jazz club does Joe Gardner dream of playing?

replacement.question: In Soul, what is the name of the jazz legend Joe Gardner finally gets to perform with at the Half Note club?

retirements.reason: #1316 explicitly supplies Half Note as the club where Joe plays. That alone answers #1292; retain the more specific musician-identification question.
